title: [compile] Recompilations due to backend mismatch
error_description: Consider this code where a fresh backend function is created on every instance of `torch.compile` call. This leads to a recompilation issue because `torch.compile` guards on the backend function to check if it can reuse the previously compiled artifact. This is **intentional** because if user want to use two different backends, we want to give two different compiled artifacts. However, in this example this seems accidental on the user side. So, this issue gives you a workaround.

trigger_conditions.other_conditions: Creating a fresh backend function on every instance of torch.compile call

add_fix_code: # Test that torch.utils._pytree.tree_is_leaf is not traced into
# when is_leaf parameter is None (the common case)
# Lists are not leaves (they're in SUPPORTED_NODES)
# Test that torch.utils._pytree.tree_is_leaf handles namedtuples correctly
# Namedtuples are not leaves (they're in SUPPORTED_NODES)
`torch.utils._pytree.tree_is_leaf` function is a hot function. We want to special case it to reduce Dynamo tracing time.
if is_leaf is not None and is_leaf(tree):
When is_leaf is None (the common case), we can optimize by not tracing into the function.
When is_leaf is not None, we fall back to regular tracing since it requires executing user code.
# Check if is_leaf parameter is provided
isinstance(is_leaf, variables.ConstantVariable) and is_leaf.value is None
# Optimize the case where is_leaf is None
# If the SUPPORTED_NODES was seen earlier and mutated, there would be a
# source and that will give us the mutated SUPPORTED_NODES.
backend=None,  # no need to set this because we are trying to find the offending guard entry
# None of the guard entries failed - a backend match issue
"BACKEND_MATCH failure: torch.compile detected different backend callables."
" If this is unexpected, wrap your backend in functools.partial (or reuse the"
" same cached backend) to avoid creating a new backend function each time."
# Unexpected recompilation - points to a bug
"Unexpected recompilation: runtime guards failed even though they passed"
" Please open an issue with a minimal repro:"
